# Maia-3 opponent

Source: [CSSLab/maia3](https://github.com/CSSLab/maia3), revision `1e13597c42d4858b7cfd7cfdae01e297263364b2`. The unmodified inference library and its AGPL-3.0 license are retained in `vendor/maia3/`. The separate Python environment is generated by `scripts/setup-opponent.sh`.

Weights: [UofTCSSLab/Maia3-5M](https://huggingface.co/UofTCSSLab/Maia3-5M). The downloaded model card is retained with the checkpoint in `vendor/maia-model/`. Refer to the upstream repository and model card for distribution terms.

Chess Study runs the model locally on CPU through its own JSON worker (`scripts/opponent.py`). The model's human move policy chooses opponent candidates; Stockfish provides searched evaluations for teaching and grading. No user games are sent to Hugging Face or another service during play.
